interpretation_rule: A bootstrap p-value below 0.10 rejects the fitted power-law tail. Otherwise the power law is not rejected, but it is not established unless the tail is substantial and alternatives are disfavored. A positive likelihood ratio favors the power law; a negative ratio favors the truncated lognormal.
limitations: The graph is a semantic k-nearest-neighbor construction, not an observed causal or temporal network.
The union-of-eight-neighbors rule mechanically constrains the lower degree distribution.
Results depend on risk-card wording, BGE-M3 embeddings, cosine threshold, and retained taxonomy inventory.
Network centrality does not measure probability, severity, impact, or regulatory priority.
